candidates.change_summary: Replace the accumulation 'balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;' with an assignment 'balances[msg.sender]= msg.value;', so prior balance is lost.
Delete the statement 'balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;' so deposits never update the balance.
Replace '+=' addition of msg.value with subtraction 'balances[msg.sender]-= msg.value;', reversing the deposit effect.
Credit a constant 1 instead of msg.value: 'balances[msg.sender]+= 1;'.
Credit a different key (tx.origin) instead of msg.sender, making balances at a non-caller key differ.
Delete the statement 'MinSum = _val;' so SetMinSum no longer changes MinSum.
Invert the initialization guard to 'if(!intitalized)revert();' so SetMinSum reverts unless Initialized() was already called.
Remove the 'if(intitalized)revert();' guard so SetMinSum also updates MinSum after initialization.
Change the assignment to 'MinSum += _val;' so SetMinSum adds to the existing MinSum instead of overwriting it.
Delete the statement `MinSum = _val;` so SetMinSum no longer updates MinSum.
Replace the assignment `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = _val + 1;` so the stored MinSum differs.
Delete the guard `if(intitalized)revert();` so SetMinSum can still modify MinSum after initialization.
Delete the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard so SetLogFile can still overwrite Log after initialization, changing the logged-to address observable afterward.
Replace `Log = LogFile(_log);` with `Log = LogFile(address(0));` so every subsequent AddMessage call targets address 0 instead of the configured log address.
